Score path: SPARK_GLM52_CHAIN_MODE=linear, SPARK_GLM52_PREFILL_WAVE_ROWS=8 (bit-exact to one-row prefill, #1373), pinned experts, prefix reuse off, 16 sequences x 2048 positions, SPARK_MODEL_BATCH_SEQUENTIAL=1, CT-short as 20 batch files of 10 documents with output budget 1. Pass 1 (U2) probes targets.bin; pass 2 (U3p, U0) probes the union of U2's per-segment probe-out files. Tier-2 rows are recorded; exact KL is not part of this plan's verdict. Execution is split across FULL-hour windows: an arm is scored in residentd segments that end at batch-file boundaries; each segment is merged against the same probe file and the segments are combined in corpus order before export; a segment that does not end cleanly is discarded and its files are scored again. A/A: U2 is scored a second time (same firmware, config and probe file) and the two combined merged dumps must be bit-identical before any verdict.
